excerpt: Tsarin index don auna shirin quantum-safe na banki a 2026: cryptographic bill of materials, tsarin hybrid TLS, ci gaban ƙaura zuwa NIST FIPS 203 / 204 / 205, primitives na crypto-agility, da bayyanar harvest-now-decrypt-later a bayanan sirri na dadewa. Quantum Scorecard na Allunan Gudanarwa ya bayyana kashi huɗu daidai — cikar kayyade, bayyanar HNDL, ci gaban ƙaura ta NIST, shirin crypto-agility — wanda ya mai da matsayin ayyuka zuwa shaida da ta dace da masu sa ido.
